title: pretty RUBY|Plus Size Convertible Lace-Up Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This versatile convertible bridesmaid dress offers endless styling options to suit every bridal party. Crafted from soft chiffon, it provides a flowy, flattering fit for all body types. The lace-up back ensures a customizable fit, while the lightweight fabric adds comfort and elegance, making it perfect for any wedding style or venue.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
